verdict.line: You lose extended trades fought near walls where her Tentacles and Test of Spirit echo pile up, but you can win short, decisive all-ins at levels 1-5 while her E is down.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive spawns Tentacles on nearby terrain that swing at spirits, Vessels, and anyone hit by her E, and her E itself echoes damage the spirit takes back onto you — so standing near walls or dragging out a trade near terrain is what actually loses this lane, not raw stats. Volibear's Q stun and W recast heal are built for short, violent bursts, which is exactly the trade length that avoids her whole kit's scaling mechanism. The data agrees: 46.3% win rate over 1196 games, lane and solo-kill advantage both Illaoi, defensive shape.

theirWindow.when: She lands E (Test of Spirit) on you
theirWindow.what: Kill the spirit fast and away from terrain. Any damage the spirit takes from Illaoi's attacks or nearby Tentacles echoes back onto you, and if the spirit survives or you flee too far, you become a Vessel that spawns Tentacles directly on top of you.

yourWindow.when: Her Q (Tentacle Smash) and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Dash in with Q (Thundering Smash) to stun her, then land W (Frenzied Maul) twice on the same target for the recast's bonus damage and heal. Without Tentacle Smash's bonus Tentacle damage or an E punish available, this is your cleanest all-in, especially pre-6 before her ultimate.

powerCurve.note: Neither combo is online, keep trades short
Harsh Lesson spam plus E vessel threat
Her R adds burst, your R's CD still long
Full build and faster R let you split-push

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The dominant start at 71% pick and 45.6% win rate — the mana and health regen offset the chip damage from her low-cooldown W (Harsh Lesson, 4s CD) and let you spam your own Q/W/E through the laning phase.

boots.why: Illaoi's entire kit is physical — Tentacle Smash, Harsh Lesson, and every Tentacle hit. Steelcaps (47.5% WR, 55.1% pick) directly blunts that poke.

core.why: Faster ability rotations mean more Q stun windows and more W recasts per trade, which is how you win the short fights this matchup rewards.
Crit-driven cooldown refund keeps your Q/W loop coming back online faster, letting you re-engage before she can reset with another E.
Armor plus anti-heal directly answers her physical damage and shuts down the healing she gets from Tentacles hitting you — part of the 51.8% win-rate core path.

situational.when: she's already sustaining off Tentacle hits early and you need the anti-heal online before Thornmail completes
the game is going long and you need more healing amp to make your W recast heal and sustain items actually matter
the lane is lost and you're leaning on waveclear and split-push to use your R's tower-disable instead of dueling her

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking attack speed compounds with your own passive's attack-speed grants, so once you land a Q stun you win the follow-up auto/W trade — and it's the dominant page here at 31.6% pick with the higher win rate (46.5%) of the two listed setups.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash posts the highest win rate of the three listed combos (50.7%) and directly answers the two moments that lose you this lane: her all-in burst and the window right after she lands E, where cutting her damage and healing keeps you from spiraling into a Vessel. Flash+Ignite remains the majority pick (77.9%) if you want more kill pressure instead.

playing.title: Track her Test of Spirit cooldown
playing.detail: E is 16/15/14/13/12s on cooldown by rank. Early levels when it's down the longest are your best windows to force a short trade.

playing.title: Never fight against walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at spirits, Vessels, and anyone she's hit with E, healing her whenever they land on a champion. Pull fights into open lane space instead.

playing.title: Open with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Q (Thundering Smash, 12-10s CD) gains speed toward her and stuns the first enemy it hits — use it to start the trade before she can land Harsh Lesson or E on you.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: W (Frenzied Maul) recast on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you. Always look to land it twice in a short trade to offset her Tentacle healing.

playing.title: Don't linger if she lands E
playing.detail: If Test of Spirit hits you, kill the spirit immediately and well away from terrain. Damage it takes echoes back onto you, and letting it survive or running too far turns you into a Vessel that spawns more Tentacles on you.

playing.title: Hold E for her poke, not to open
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (16s CD, 1200 range) slows and shields you if you're caught in it — save it to punish her Tentacle Smash poke rather than leading with it and giving away the shield's position.

playing.title: Use R to split, not to duel
playing.detail: Stormbringer's temporary tower-disable is a split-push and objective tool. If the lane's gone defensive, look for side-lane plates instead of forcing a duel she's favored in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (88,127 Volibear top games, 1196 Volibear-vs-Illaoi games); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Illaoi’s (E) in line. Purchase Bramble Vest and use [E] to contest lane while waiting for the enemy’s skills to be on cooldown.
